## 方法判定
- 已给解法：矩阵解法
- 本次给出：线性空间解法

## 另一种解法
This is a linear space solution.

Let \(V=\mathbb R^2\). Write the ordered bases as
\[
B=(b_1,b_2),\qquad C=(c_1,c_2),
\]
where
\[
b_1=\begin{pmatrix}5\\2\end{pmatrix},\quad
b_2=\begin{pmatrix}1\\3\end{pmatrix},\quad
c_1=\begin{pmatrix}-2\\3\end{pmatrix},\quad
c_2=\begin{pmatrix}1\\-2\end{pmatrix}.
\]
The coordinate maps
\[
[\cdot]_B:V\to\mathbb R^2,\qquad [\cdot]_C:V\to\mathbb R^2
\]
are linear isomorphisms. The required matrix \(P\) is the matrix of the identity map \(\operatorname{id}_V\) with respect to the ordered bases \(B\) and \(C\):
\[
P=[\operatorname{id}_V]_{C\leftarrow B}.
\]
Thus the \(j\)-th column of \(P\) is the \(C\)-coordinate vector of \(b_j\). We need \([b_1]_C\) and \([b_2]_C\).

Take a general vector \(v=(r,s)\). Express it as a linear combination of \(c_1,c_2\):
\[
v=\alpha c_1+\beta c_2.
\]
Then
\[
\alpha\begin{pmatrix}-2\\3\end{pmatrix}
+\beta\begin{pmatrix}1\\-2\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}r\\s\end{pmatrix},
\]
so
\[
-2\alpha+\beta=r,\qquad 3\alpha-2\beta=s.
\]
Solving gives
\[
\alpha=-2r-s,\qquad \beta=-3r-2s.
\]
Therefore
\[
[v]_C=
\begin{pmatrix}-2r-s\\-3r-2s\end{pmatrix}.
\]
Applying this to \(b_1=(5,2)\),
\[
[b_1]_C=
\begin{pmatrix}-2(5)-2\\-3(5)-2(2)\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}-12\\-19\end{pmatrix}.
\]
Applying this to \(b_2=(1,3)\),
\[
[b_2]_C=
\begin{pmatrix}-2(1)-3\\-3(1)-2(3)\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}-5\\-9\end{pmatrix}.
\]
Hence the columns of \(P\) are \([b_1]_C\) and \([b_2]_C\):
\[
P=
\begin{pmatrix}
-12 & -5\\
-19 & -9
\end{pmatrix}.
\]

## 步骤对应
| 已有矩阵解法 | 本次线性空间解法 |
|---|---|
| 用矩阵 \(B\) 表示基 \(B\) 的列 | 看作有序基 \(B=(b_1,b_2)\) |
| 用矩阵 \(C\) 表示基 \(C\) 的列 | 看作有序基 \(C=(c_1,c_2)\) |
| \(P=C^{-1}B\) | \(P=[\operatorname{id}_V]_{C\leftarrow B}\)，列向量为 \([b_j]_C\) |
| 求 \(C^{-1}\) | 解 \(v=\alpha c_1+\beta c_2\)，得到 \(C\)-坐标公式 |
| 计算 \(C^{-1}B\) 的列 | 计算 \([b_1]_C=(-12,-19)\)，\([b_2]_C=(-5,-9)\) |
| 按列写出 \(P\) | 将上述坐标向量作为列写出 \(P\) |

## 约定
- 有序基 \(B=(b_1,b_2)\)、\(C=(c_1,c_2)\) 按题目给出顺序。
- \(P\) 的列依次为 \([b_1]_C,[b_2]_C\)。

来源：继承已有解法

## 答案
\[
P=
\begin{pmatrix}
-12 & -5\\
-19 & -9
\end{pmatrix}
\]

## 可核对结论
- 类型：矩阵
- 结论：-12 | -5 | -19 | -9
- 约定：\(P\) 的列依次为 \([b_1]_C,[b_2]_C\)，基顺序按题目
- 约定来源：继承已有解法

## 检验
Check the two columns by expressing \(b_1,b_2\) in the basis \(C\).

For \(b_1\),
\[
-12c_1-19c_2
=
-12\begin{pmatrix}-2\\3\end{pmatrix}
-19\begin{pmatrix}1\\-2\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}24-19\\-36+38\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}5\\2\end{pmatrix}
=b_1.
\]
For \(b_2\),
\[
-5c_1-9c_2
=
-5\begin{pmatrix}-2\\3\end{pmatrix}
-9\begin{pmatrix}1\\-2\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}10-9\\-15+18\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}1\\3\end{pmatrix}
=b_2.
\]
Thus for every \(x\in\mathbb R^2\), if \([x]_B=(r,s)\), then
\[
[x]_C=r[b_1]_C+s[b_2]_C=P[x]_B,
\]
as required.

【题目】
Let $B$ be the basis of ${\mathbb R}^2$ consisting of the vectors \left\lbrace \left[\begin{array}{c} 5\cr 2 \end{array}\right], \left[\begin{array}{c} 1\cr 3 \end{array}\right] \right\rbrace, and let $C$ be the basis consisting of \left\lbrace \left[\begin{array}{c}-2\cr 3 \end{array}\right], \left[\begin{array}{c} 1\cr-2 \end{array}\right] \right\rbrace.
Find a matrix $P$ such that $[\vec{x}]_C=P [\vec{x}]_B$ for all $\vec{x}$ in ${\mathbb R}^2$.
$P=$ \begin {array}{cc} [ANS] & [ANS] \\ [ANS] & [ANS] \end{array}

In the section 可核对结论, the line starting with 结论 must contain only the [ANS] values in order, separated by ' | '. Do not add words on that line.

【已有解法类型】
矩阵解法

【必须给出】
线性空间解法

【翻译规则】
这是翻译，不是重新选题。沿用已有解法里合法的不唯一选择，不要改成你自己更习惯的取法。
若其中有计算错误，可核对结论写改正后的结果；约定仍沿用说得通的原取法，并在检验中指出错误。

【已有解法】
Matrix solution.
Let the columns of B be (5,2) and (1,3), and the columns of C be (-2,3) and (1,-2), in the given order.
The change-of-coordinate matrix satisfies P = C^{-1} B.
det(C)=(-2)(-2)-(1)(3)=1, so C^{-1} = [ -2  -1 ; -3  -2 ].
Then P = C^{-1} B = [ -12  -5 ; -19  -9 ].
Convention locked by this solution: do not swap the ordered bases, so the columns stay in this order.
Checkable values: -12, -5, -19, -9.
